Hello, my friend! I am Ananse. Today we are learning about big and small.
Look at these two drums. This one is big.
Big and small always need two things, side by side.
Here is one ball, all by itself. Is it big, or is it small? We cannot say yet.
Watch. Here comes a tiny ball.
Now our ball is the big one.
The tiny ball goes away, and a big one rolls in.
Now the very same ball is the small one.
Nothing about our ball changed. Only what stood beside it.
Your turn. Look at these two oranges. Which one is big?
Yes! This orange is the big one.
Now a bigger orange comes, and the same orange is the small one.
So, big and small tell us how two things look together.
At home, hold up two things. Which is big? Which is small?
